notes.title: 2024/04/09 Endless Mode Patch
notes.notes:
・The difficulty increase rate of Endless Mode has been significantly nerfed. Now, Endless Mode can truly be played indefinitely.

・Now, when the Archmage's projectiles reach a certain count, a black projectile with the damage of 12 projectiles is fired.

・Fixed a bug where moving to another screen before reward settlement would not apply the rewards.


・Artifact Balance Adjustments

"With the patch to Endless Mode, artifacts that were strong in Endless Mode have been adjusted."

Investment Genius
- When selling summons, you receive back 80->75% of the cost.

Hermes, God of Commerce
- When selling summons, you receive back 90->80% of the cost.

Ares' Negotiation, Kratos' Mediator
- Similar to Nike's Festival and Demeter's Flow, the efficiency decreases as discount costs overlap.

notes.title: 2024/04/01 Timer, HP Patch
notes.notes:
" This is a patch to lower the difficulty that was increased due to a previous patch." 

・Now, the timer does not run while in combat with bosses or elites. 
(Meaning, even if you fight for a long time or run away, you will not lose time and money.)

・The game's base speed is slightly faster.

・Bosses and elites are now better blocked by the bodies of summons.

・Fixed a bug where projectiles from the King Crab and Fire Horse did not deal damage if they grew beyond a certain size. 
(This is probably why you died in infinite mode.)

notes.title: 2024/03/08 Black Screen on startup, Balance Patch
notes.notes:
・We have identified and possibly resolved an issue where certain users were unable to move past a black screen at startup. 
(If the same symptom occurs again, please post on the discussion board!)

・Difficulty of Challange Stage 3 has been lowered.


・Artifact balance patch

Summoning Ritual
- (Before) Two owned Summons die randomly, and the player's max HP decreases by 20%. Obtain a random 300-cost 2-star Summon.
- (After) The cheapest Summon dies randomly, and you obtain a random 300-cost Summon.

Revenge of the same race

notes.title: 2024/03/07 Difficulty Revamp Patch
notes.notes:
Currently, this game has challenges up to stage 7. 
However, statistically, most players do not reach the higher stages, and the clear rate is also low.

Therefore, through this difficulty patch, we aim to enable many players to reach level 7, 
and to have more players experience clearing the game.

Our game's intended difficulty is actually completed at level 7. 
We consider everything before that as a stage for learning how to play the game.

(We plan to add level 8 and 9 trials in the future for skilled players.)

(We also recommend trying out summons that require being DPS No. 1 in achievements at least once.)


・Difficulty Revamp Patch

- Increase player's base movement speed from 1.6 to 1.7

- Increase summon's base movement speed by 10%

- Improved how summons block bosses and elites (more than the last patch)

- Decrease difficulty for trials of levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

- Decrease difficulty for bosses/elites in level 2 trials

- Decrease enemy health in level 3 trials from 15% to 10%

- Change the bonus for completing the recipe from max population +1 at 100% progress to an additional effect at 50% progress.

- Add a new bonus for 100% progress of the recipe.

- Add a new bonus for achieving 100% in achievements.


・Artifact Balance Patch

Trot
- Decrease player's movement speed bonus from 12% to 10%

Healthy Body
- Decrease player's movement speed bonus from 18% to 15%

Demeter, Goddess of the Earth
- Decrease player's movement speed bonus from 24% to 20%

Free Reroll Related
- Fix a bug where free rerolls triggered additional free rerolls (nerf)

- Increase permanent critical rate from 3% to 8% (max 60% to 80%)

Endless Revenge
- Increase permanent critical rate from 5% to 10% (max 80% to 100%)

Nemesis, Goddess of Revenge
- Increase permanent critical rate from 10% to 12% (max 100% to 120%)
